notes:
Summary: SentryWave is a contact center platform serving financial services and retail clients. Primary ask = real-time agent assist: streaming suggestions, auto-suggest snippets, and safe tool-calls into their CRM. Key constraints: strict EU data residency for some customers, PCI scope for payment agents, and hard latency targets (median <120ms, 95p <250ms) during spikes.

Recent call highlights: 
- Product: they run 500 agents globally, typical concurrency 120 agents, expect seasonal spikes to 1200 concurrent. Want proof that Redwood Dedicated can maintain SLOs under 10x spike.
- Guardrails: must redact PII from suggestions and have immutable audit trail for every tool-call. Legal: "We cannot accept any outbound model calls that leak payment tokens."
- Integration: need tool-calling patterns (open ticket, update status, initiate refund flow), prefer function-calling style with explicit confirmations.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for Dedicated but want Optimize recommendations to reduce per-token spend.

POC scope agreed: 2-week Dedicated test — load test with synthetic spike, end-to-end tool-calling demo with audit logging, SSO integration (SAML) and KMS for key wrapping.

Open questions / follow-ups: 
- Exact list of PII fields to redact (legal).
- Network egress routing for EU residency — need infra diagram and support from Redwood infra team.
- Acceptance criteria for latency under 10x traffic (benchmark scripts needed).

Stubs / links: pricing deck in Drive, security FAQ; referenced Fireflies IDs above. Next: schedule infra scoping call and send POC success criteria doc.
